response:
FADE IN:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

We see a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor, merchants hawking their wares, and peasants scurrying about. But amidst the chaos, we notice something peculiar. The king, a stout and jovial man named KING REGINALD, is pacing back and forth in front of a large, ornate mirror.

KING REGINALD
(to himself)
Something's missing. This kingdom needs a new aesthetic.

Suddenly, a court jester, JESTER PIPER, approaches the king.

JESTER PIPER
Your Majesty, what seems to be the matter?

KING REGINALD
I'm tired of the same old suits of armor and banners. I want something new, something... futuristic.

JESTER PIPER
Futuristic, Your Majesty? But this is the Middle Ages!

KING REGINALD
Exactly! That's what I mean. We need to blend the old with the new. The ancient with the avant-garde.

JESTER PIPER
I see what you mean, Your Majesty. But how do you propose we achieve this?

KING REGINALD
Leave that to me. I've been studying the art of... vaporwave.

JESTER PIPER
Vaporwave? But that's a music genre, Your Majesty!

KING REGINALD
Ah, yes. But it's also a aesthetic. A way of life. And I intend to bring it to our kingdom.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

KING REGINALD is surrounded by a team of courtiers, who are frantically trying to create a vaporwave-inspired makeover for the kingdom.

COURTIER 1
Your Majesty, we're having trouble finding the right fabrics. The velvet and satin just don't have the right... sheen.

KING REGINALD
Sheen? Ah, yes. That's the ticket. Get me some iridescent fabrics, stat!

COURTIER 2
But, Your Majesty, what about the armor? We can't just replace the steel with... with... whatever it is you want to use.

KING REGINALD
Ah, the armor. Leave that to me. I've got a team of artisans working on some... innovative designs.

CUT TO:

EXT. KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is transformed. The knights are now clad in shimmering, neon-colored armor, while the merchants peddle their wares on stalls adorned with holographic displays. The peasants scurry about, wearing outfits that seem to shift and change color in the light.

KING REGINALD
(to himself)
Yes. This is it. This is the future.

JESTER PIPER
Your Majesty, I think it's... um... quite a unique aesthetic.

KING REGINALD
Unique? Ha! This is the future, my friend. And I'm the king of the future.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

KING REGINALD is sitting on his throne, surrounded by his courtiers. He's wearing a suit of armor that seems to be made of... of... something that's not quite metal.

KING REGINALD
(to his courtiers)
I want to make a statement. A statement about the power of innovation and progress.

COURTIER 1
But, Your Majesty, what about the, uh, practicality of it all?

KING REGINALD
Practicality? Ha! I'm a king, not a accountant. I want to make a statement.

CUT TO:

EXT. KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is in full swing. The knights are jousting with... with... holographic horses. The merchants are selling... selling... whatever it is they're selling. And the peasants are... well, they're just trying to keep up.

KING REGINALD
(to himself)
Yes. This is it. This is the future.

JESTER PIPER
Your Majesty, I think it's... um... quite a... a... thing.

KING REGINALD
A thing? Ha! This is the future, my friend. And I'm the king of the future.

FADE TO BLACK.
